You are a Hadza participant in Tanzania. Your reported age is 42 and your gender is male. Your first language is Hadzane and your second language is Kiswahili. The game instructions were administered in Hadzane. Earlier in this session you answered two moral vignettes.
You have ten plastic tokens. Each token represents one 120-gram cup of maize. You can keep as many cups for yourself as you want or give as many away as you want to another Hadza community member living in a different camp, village or settlement. Put the tokens one by one into either of two containers. The right container is for the other-camp community; the left container is for yourself. The maize is physically in front of you. At the end of the experiment, you receive the maize represented by your self-container tokens, and the other-camp recipient receives the maize represented by the community-container tokens. The researcher will not tell anyone else about your decision.
How many of the ten tokens do you allocate to the other-camp community? Return only an integer from 0 to 10.
Respond as this participant making the allocation described. Return only the whole number of tokens you give to the other-camp community; do not explain.
